theory.title: Comprende y da consejos sencillos en la consulta
theory.explanation: Usamos should + verbo en forma base para dar consejos: You should rest. Para decir que algo no es recomendable, usamos shouldn't + verbo: You shouldn't work today. Para preguntar si conviene hacer algo, colocamos should delante del sujeto: Should I call the doctor? La forma should no cambia con I, you, he, she, we o they, y el verbo que sigue no lleva -s ni to.
theory.tip: Should y shouldn't expresan consejo, no una obligación absoluta. En esta misión aparecen en diálogos de ejemplo para practicar inglés; no sustituyen la valoración de un profesional sanitario. Recuerda: should rest, no should to rest ni should rests.

patterns.label: Answer a question about advice
patterns.pattern: Yes, you should. / No, you shouldn't.
examples: Should I go to school? No, you shouldn't.

patterns.label: Use the same form with every subject
patterns.pattern: I / you / he / she / we / they + should + base verb

content.passage: Sara has an appointment at the clinic. She has got a cough and a high temperature. She is tired. The doctor asks, “Are you OK?” Sara says, “I'm not very well.” The doctor says, “You should rest and drink some water.” Sara asks, “Should I go to work?” The doctor says, “No, you shouldn't.” “You should stay at home today,” says the doctor. Sara says, “Thank you, doctor.”
